purpose: Test whether native SW0097 source QCC foreground assignments have local pairwise agreement with frozen CLEVR object masks.

prediction_contract.model: immutable SW0097 native source checkpoint for the corresponding seed
prediction_contract.gamma: registered cached validation gamma, rows for global image IDs 1320..1335
prediction_contract.q: spike_synchrony_affinity(actual_component_spikes.mean(dim=1), components=actual_component_spikes, settle=512, affinity_mode='spike'); each component Pearson is clamped positive by the registered function before product
prediction_contract.native_rollout_parity: manual source rollout must exactly match production theta/component membrane/component spikes and QCC labels for two fixed samples per seed

pair_qa.pairing: unique unordered patch pairs; Euclidean distance on the 16x16 patch grid; exclude self-pairs
pair_qa.positive: both predicted labels are the same non-background label and Q >= 0.9
pair_qa.negative: predicted labels differ (including background-vs-foreground) and Q <= 0.1
pair_qa.foreground_relevant_denominator: candidate pair has at least one non-background modal-8x8 ground-truth patch label; background-background pairs are reported separately and excluded
pair_qa.positive_correct: both patches share the same non-background ground-truth object label
pair_qa.negative_correct: the pair does not share the same non-background ground-truth object label
pair_qa.eligible_anchor: predicted foreground anchor has at least one positive and one negative candidate in that same distance bin; this decision is frozen before GT access
pair_qa.eligible_image_bin: at least one eligible foreground anchor exists for that image and distance bin
pair_qa.connected_component_merges: count each predicted foreground QCC label whose patches overlap more than one non-background ground-truth object ID

acceptance.failure_action: close this QA result; no threshold tuning, training, or 70k expansion

ground_truth_ordering: Generate and persist all three seed predictions and Q matrices first. Rehash the single complete prediction bundle and validate all seed shapes/provenance before opening the HDF5 masks. GT is used only for post-freeze scoring.
output_policy: Create-only paths. Preserve any existing output/result and never overwrite or automatically rerun it. A completed failed QA gate is a scientific result, not a process error.
